summary: Verified the /reader-assets/ -> /api/static-asset/ asset-path fix on reader, morts-entry, landing, and root pages at mobile (390x844) and desktop viewports. All primary logo/manifest/icon assets now load correctly with correct content-types. Manifest JSON is valid and its icon URLs resolve to real PNGs. Core UI on reader (silo cards, shed 1&2 etc.) and morts-entry (10 shed cards + Save) still renders and functions.

issues: Three secondary screenshot images under /api/static-asset/screenshots/reader-today.jpg, reader-weigh.jpg, reader-history.jpg return 404 (naturalWidth=0). Not part of the current fix but a broken-image regression visible on the landing page's screenshot gallery section.
Non-blocking pageerror in console: 'Cannot set properties of null (setting onclick)' — pre-existing, does not prevent reader UI from rendering or saving, but should be investigated.

action_items: Optional: upload/copy the missing landing screenshots (screenshots/reader-today.jpg, reader-weigh.jpg, reader-history.jpg) into the static-asset mount, or update landing.html/index.html to point to existing images.
Investigate the recurring 'Cannot set properties of null (setting onclick)' page error on reader.html and landing.html — likely a missing DOM node the script tries to bind before it exists.
critical_code_review_comments: Global replace worked cleanly across reader.html, morts-entry.html, logo.svg, and index.html JSON-LD.
Reader page has a non-fatal JS error on load — worth fixing to prevent silent breakage if a future refactor removes another element.
Landing page still references some screenshot assets that were not migrated / do not exist under /api/static-asset/screenshots/ — either the folder wasn't served or files are missing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Asset-path fix (/reader-assets -> /api/static-asset) is verified across reader, morts-entry, landing, and /. Manifest + icon-192/icon-512 load with correct MIME types. Only two leftover items: (a) 3 landing 'screenshots/' images return 404, (b) a benign pageerror on reader/landing about setting onclick on null.
rca of the issue: Original problem: /reader-assets/* was being intercepted by the frontend SPA fallback and returned HTML instead of the real assets, so PWA manifest + icons + logo silently 200'd as text/html and never installed. Fix relocated all references to /api/static-asset/* which is a real FastAPI StaticFiles mount that bypasses the SPA fallback. Verified via network: content-type is now image/png, image/svg+xml, application/json respectively; naturalWidth>0 for header logos on reader/morts-entry/landing/root.
